# Delivery planning review

Use `docs/delivery/README.md` as workflow authority, its plan template for structure, and the delivery issue template
for proposed issue bodies. Use `docs/requirements/README.md` for requirement authority and
`docs/engineering/testing/README.md` for evidence boundaries.

Review accepted criterion coverage, outcome-oriented slices, explicit partial scope, blockers, enabling-work justification,
real dependencies, duplicate-work limits, and source-pinned issue links. Parent containment and blocking are distinct.
Templates intentionally contain placeholders; concrete plans must replace them. Planned evidence and existing code are
not executed verification. Agent findings do not approve decomposition; apply the guide's recorded state transitions.

Keep unresolved policies visible. Do not infer product approval, invent issue URLs or execution evidence, demand
historical Spec Kit synchronization, or recommend automatic publication, Projects automation, or an RTM for this workflow.
Report actionable planning defects separately from legitimate blocked or unverified work.
